messages.content: By how much did the amount charged, before any reimbursement, for care by executing professionals practising in Grand Est change from claims processed in January 2025 to claims processed in February 2025? Return February's total minus January's.

input.sql: select r.BEN_RES_REG, r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB from DIM_REGION r where BEN_RES_REG_LIB ilike '%grand%' or BEN_RES_REG=44 union all select distinct FLX_ANN_MOI, 'x' from FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS where FLX_ANN_MOI between 202412 and 202503

input.final_sql:
select sum(case when FLX_ANN_MOI=202502 then PRS_PAI_MNT else 0 end) - sum(case when FLX_ANN_MOI=202501 then PRS_PAI_MNT else 0 end) as diff
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
where EXE_INS_REG=44 and FLX_ANN_MOI in (202501,202502)
